scope: Read-only R3.8 handling and pedal Auto audit; no implementation or TouchDrive assumption

findings.issue: Explicit brake input is discarded by pedal Auto
findings.status: Reproduced; all implementation paused pending verified TouchDrive direction

findings.issue: Ultra tap canceled by pedal Auto
findings.cause: Cruise target reads input.ultraBoost only, not existing player.ultraBoosting state

findings.issue: Binary stop control chatters and ignores Explore endpoint warnings
findings.note: No collisions or damage in barrier probe; endpoint behavior relies on existing automatic recovery rather than anticipatory pedal stop.

input_loss_review: blur and hidden explicitly clear controls and pause; focus/visible do not resume. Capture gates helper inputs and UI clears Auto. These are code-reviewed plus existing suite coverage, not fresh browser evidence.
manual_physics_assessment: No evidence justifying a broad grip/braking/steering retune; current fixed-step steering envelope, rack/yaw smoothing and momentum/grip mechanics should remain until measured playtesting suggests changes.
